cook.name: Cook's Assistant
cook.start: Talk to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen.
rewards: Permission to use the Cook's range

1.text: Talk to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen to start the quest.

2.text: Buy a bucket from the Lumbridge General Store.

3.text: Buy a pot from the Lumbridge General Store.

4.text: Pick up an egg from the chicken farm north of Lumbridge, across the river.

5.text: Pick some wheat in the field north of Lumbridge.

6.text: Climb the ladder in the mill to the top floor.

7.text: Climb up the ladder again to the top floor.

8.text: Use your grain on the hopper.

9.text: Pull the hopper controls.

10.text: Climb down the ladder to the ground floor.

11.text: Climb down the ladder to the ground floor.

12.text: Use your pot on the flour bin to collect the flour.

13.text: Use your bucket on a cow in the field north of the mill.

14.text: Bring the Cook the egg, the milk and the flour.

priestperil.name: Priest in Peril
priestperil.start: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace.
skills: Able to defeat a level 30 dog and level 30 monks

1.text: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace.

2.text: Knock at the temple door, east of Varrock where the River Salve starts, and say Roald sent you.
options: Roald sent me to check on Drezel.

3.text: Open and climb down the trapdoor in the mausoleum north of the temple.

4.text: Kill the temple guardian, the dog in the room underground.

5.text: Climb back up the ladder.

6.text: Go back to King Roald in Varrock Palace and tell him the dog is dead.

7.text: Go into the temple (the doors are open now) and up the stairs. Zamorakian monks (level 30) attack you inside.

8.text: Climb the ladder to the top floor.

9.text: Talk-through the cell door to Drezel. Pick 'Tell me anyway.' and then 'Yes.'

10.text: Kill the Zamorakian monks in the temple until one drops a golden key, and pick it up.

11.text: Take the golden key down the trapdoor in the mausoleum north of the temple.

12.text: Go through the gate and study the monuments: use the golden key on the one that reads 'Saradomin is the key that unlocks the mysteries of life' to swap it for the iron key.

13.text: Use a bucket on the well in the middle of the monuments to fill it with murky water.

14.text: You need water from the well under the mausoleum: take a bucket down the trapdoor north of the temple.

15.text: Climb back up the ladder and go to the top of the temple.

16.text: Go up the stairs in the temple.

17.text: Climb the ladder to the top floor.

18.text: Use the iron key on the cell door.

19.text: Use the bucket of murky water on Drezel so he blesses it.

20.text: Use the blessed water on the vampire's coffin.

21.text: Talk to Drezel.

22.text: Go down the trapdoor in the mausoleum north of the temple to meet Drezel by the monuments.

23.text: Go through the gates past the monuments and talk to Drezel in the room to the east.

24.text: Bring Drezel 50 rune essence (not noted). He takes them under the mausoleum, past the monuments.

25.text: Use the rune essence on Drezel, past the monuments under the mausoleum.

waterfall.name: Waterfall Quest
waterfall.start: Talk to Almera in her house north of the Baxtorian Falls.
skills: Glarial's tomb lets in no weapons, armour, runes or arrows: bank them first

1.text: Talk to Almera in her house north of the Baxtorian Falls.

2.text: Board the log raft by the river to float down to Hudon.

3.text: Talk to Hudon on the island.

4.text: Leave the island: swim for the rock to the south and the current washes you ashore.

5.text: Go to Hadley's house by the falls and climb the stairs.

6.text: Search the bookcase for the Book on Baxtorian.

7.text: Read the Book on Baxtorian.

8.text: Go into the Tree Gnome Village (through the maze) and climb down the ladder to the cellar.

9.text: Search the crate in the far east of the cellar for a key.

10.text: Use the key on Golrie's gate and talk to Golrie.

11.text: Talk to Golrie and look through his junk for Glarial's pebble.

12.text: Bank every weapon, armour piece, rune and arrow, then use Glarial's pebble on Glarial's tombstone, east of the falls.

13.text: Open the chest in Glarial's tomb and search it for Glarial's amulet.

14.text: Search Glarial's coffin for her urn.

15.text: Climb the ladder out of the tomb.

16.text: Back to the falls with a rope, 6 air, 6 earth and 6 water runes, Glarial's amulet and urn: board the log raft.

17.text: Use the rope on the rock to the south.

18.text: Use the rope on the dead tree to let yourself down onto the ledge.

19.text: Wear Glarial's amulet and open the door into the falls.

20.text: Search the crate in the east of the cave for a key.

21.text: Use the key on the door in the north-west of the cave.

22.text: Use an air, an earth and a water rune on each of the six pillars.

23.text: Use Glarial's amulet on the statue of Glarial.

24.text: With 5 free spaces, use Glarial's urn on the chalice.

troll.name: Troll Stronghold
troll.start: Talk to Denulth in his tent at the Imperial Guard camp in Burthorpe (after Death Plateau).
skills: Level 30 Thieving (to take the cell keys without a fight)
Able to defeat a level 113 troll
rewards: The way to the troll country

1.text: Talk to Denulth in his tent at the Imperial Guard camp in Burthorpe and offer to get Godric back.
options: How goes your fight with the trolls?
Is there anything I can do to help?

2.text: Buy climbing boots from Tenzing the Sherpa, west of Burthorpe (12 coins).
options: Can I buy some Climbing boots?

3.text: Wear the climbing boots, climb up Death Plateau and go through the door into the arena.

4.text: Talk to the Troll Champion (Dad), accept his challenge and defeat him (level 113).

5.text: Leave the arena by the north door.

6.text: Go north-west over the rocks (Agility 15) to the Troll Stronghold and go in through the door.

7.text: Kill one of the Troll Generals on the top floor of the stronghold for the prison key.

8.text: Go down the stairs in the north of the stronghold.

9.text: Open the prison door with the prison key.

10.text: Go down the stairs into the prison.

11.text: Pickpocket the sleeping prison guards (Thieving 30) or kill them for the cell keys: the first guard has Godric's.

12.text: Use cell key 1 on Godric's cell door.

13.text: Optional: use cell key 2 on Mad Eadgar's cell door to free him too.

14.text: Leave the stronghold by the door in the south-west of the prison level.

15.text: Tell Dunstan, the smith in Burthorpe, that his son Godric is safe.

ikov.name: Temple of Ikov
ikov.start: Talk to Lucien in the Flying Horse Inn in East Ardougne.
skills: A light source (lit candle, torch or lantern) and a tinderbox
A bow that fires ice arrows (shortbow or longbow)
You must weigh under 0 kg to cross the lava bridge

1.text: Talk to Lucien in the Flying Horse Inn in East Ardougne and agree to get the Staff of Armadyl.

2.text: With a light source, a bow and 20 limpwurt roots, climb down the ladder into the Temple of Ikov, by the statues north-east of East Ardougne.

3.text: Go down the dark stairs in the west with your light source lit.

4.text: Pick up the boots of lightness, then go back up the stairs.

5.text: Wear the boots of lightness and bank or drop enough to weigh under 0 kg, cross the lava bridge and pick up the lever on the far side.

6.text: Use the lever on the lever bracket in the east, then pull it to open the gate south of it.

7.text: Go through the south gate and search the chests in the ice spiders' cave until you find ice arrows.

8.text: Wear Lucien's pendant, go through the north door (it fills you with fear without it) and search the lever for traps (Thieving 42).

9.text: Pull the lever.

10.text: Go through the door to the west and kill the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus with ice arrows (wield a bow).

11.text: Talk to Winelda in the north.

12.text: Bring Winelda 20 limpwurt roots (not noted) and talk to her: she teleports you across.

13.text: Take off Lucien's pendant and talk to a Guardian of Armadyl: side with them against Lucien.
options: I seek the Staff of Armadyl.
Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!
You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.

14.text: Take the Staff of Armadyl to Lucien in his house in north-west Varrock.

15.text: Wear the Pendant of Armadyl and kill Lucien in his house in north-west Varrock.

itexam.name: The Dig Site
itexam.start: Talk to the Examiner in the Exam Centre, south-east of Varrock past the River Salve bridge.

1.text: Talk to the Examiner in the Exam Centre.

2.text: Take the letter to the Curator of the Varrock Museum to have it stamped.

3.text: Give the stamped letter to the Examiner.

4.text: Talk to the student in the green top on the Dig Site.

5.text: Pickpocket a workman (Thieving 25) until you get the green student's rock sample.

6.text: Give the rock sample to the student in the green top.

7.text: Talk to the student in the purple shirt.

8.text: Search the bushes south of the Dig Site for the purple student's rock sample.

9.text: Give the rock sample to the student in the purple shirt.

10.text: Talk to the student in the orange top.

11.text: Give the panning guide by the river a cup of tea so he lets you pan.

12.text: Pick up a panning tray near the panning guide.

13.text: Pan at the river and search the tray until you find the orange student's rock sample.

14.text: Give the rock sample to the student in the orange top.

15.text: Take the first exam with the Examiner (the answers are in green).
options: The study of the earth, its contents, and history.
All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.
Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.

16.text: Talk to the student in the green top about the second exam.

17.text: Talk to the student in the purple shirt about the second exam.

18.text: Talk to the student in the orange top about the second exam.

19.text: Take the second exam with the Examiner (the answers are in green).
options: I am ready for the next exam.
Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers.
Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn.
Always handle with care; strike cleanly on its cleaving point.

20.text: Talk to the student in the green top about the third exam.

21.text: Talk to the student in the purple shirt about the third exam: she wants an opal (a cut one).

22.text: Talk to the student in the orange top about the third exam.

23.text: Take the third exam with the Examiner (the answers are in green).
options: I am ready for the last exam...
Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.
Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.
Handle bones very carefully and keep them away from other samples.

24.text: Search the sacks on the Dig Site for a specimen jar.

25.text: Pickpocket a workman until you get a specimen brush.

26.text: With a specimen jar and brush, use your trowel on the soil of a level 3 site until you find a strange talisman.

27.text: Show the talisman to the archaeological expert in the Exam Centre.

28.text: Use the expert's letter on a workman on the Dig Site.

29.text: Use a rope on the winch at the private dig in the north-east.

30.text: Operate the winch at the private dig to go down.

31.text: Talk to the workman in the cave and beg for his chest key.
options: I have been invited to research here.
Do you know where to find a chest key?
I don't suppose I could use it?
Pretty please with sugar on top!

32.text: Pick up an arcenia root in the cave.

33.text: Climb the ladder out of the cave.

34.text: Use the chest key on the chest by the barrels, south-east of the Dig Site, and search it.

35.text: Use your trowel on one of the barrels to open it, then use an empty vial on it.

36.text: Use the unidentified liquid and the unidentified powder on the archaeological expert.

37.text: Use the pestle and mortar on the charcoal.

38.text: Use the ammonium nitrate on the nitroglycerin.

39.text: Use the ground charcoal on the mixture.

40.text: Use the arcenia root on the mixture (Herblore 10).

41.text: Use a rope on the winch in the north-west of the Dig Site.

42.text: Operate the winch in the north-west of the Dig Site to go down.

43.text: Use the explosive compound on the bricks blocking the way.

44.text: Use the tinderbox on the bricks and run!

45.text: Pick up the stone tablet in the room you blasted open.

46.text: Give the stone tablet to the archaeological expert in the Exam Centre.

desertrescue.name: The Tourist Trap
desertrescue.start: Talk to Irena by the Shantay Pass, south of Al Kharid.
skills: No armour or weapons inside the mining camp
rewards: 4,650 experience twice in Fletching, Agility, Smithing or Thieving (you pick)
Access to the Shantay Pass desert areas

1.text: Talk to Irena by the Shantay Pass and offer to find her daughter Ana.
options: Is there a reward if I get her back?
Okay Irena, calm down. I'll get your daughter back for you.

2.text: Go south into the desert and talk to the Mercenary Captain outside the mining camp.

3.text: Kill the Mercenary Captain (level 47) for his metal key.

4.text: Take off all armour and weapons and open the camp gate with the metal key.

5.text: Talk to the male slave in the camp and offer to undo his chains.
options: I can try to undo them for you.
It's funny you should say that...
Yeah, okay, let's give it a go.

6.text: Talk to the slave again to pick the lock on his chains.
options: Yeah, okay, let's give it a go.
Yeah I'll give it another go.

7.text: With your desert shirt, robe and boots, talk to the slave and trade clothes with him.

8.text: Wear the slave's shirt, robe and boots and go through the mine doors in the north-east of the camp.

9.text: Talk to the guard in the mine and ask to mine somewhere else.
options: I'd like to mine in a different area.
Yes sir, you're quite right sir.

10.text: Leave the mine by the doors.

11.text: Talk to Al Shabim in the Bedabin Camp, north-west of the mining camp, about a pineapple.
options: I am looking for a pineapple.

12.text: Climb the ladder in the camp's north building and search Captain Siad's bookcase.

13.text: Talk to Captain Siad about sailing to distract him.
options: I wanted to have a chat?
You seem to have a lot of books!
I could tell by the cut of your jib.

14.text: While he is distracted, use the Bedobin copy key on his chest.

15.text: Show the plans to Al Shabim in the Bedabin Camp (bring the bronze bar and feathers).

16.text: Talk to the Bedabin guard by the big tent to be let in.

17.text: Use the bronze bar on the anvil in the tent (you need a hammer).

18.text: Use the feathers on the prototype dart tip (it can take a few tries).

19.text: Give the prototype dart to Al Shabim.

20.text: Back in the mine, give the Tenti pineapple to the guard.

21.text: Take an empty barrel from near the mine cart.

22.text: Squeeze into the mine cart to get deeper into the mine.

23.text: Find Ana in the deep mine and use the empty barrel on her.

24.text: Use the barrel with Ana in it on the mine cart.

25.text: Squeeze into the mine cart to go back.

26.text: Search the barrels by the mine cart for Ana.

27.text: Use Ana's barrel on the lift and get the guard to send it up.

28.text: Leave the mine and operate the lift winch in the camp.

29.text: Search the barrel by the lift for Ana.

30.text: Use Ana's barrel on the mine cart in the camp.

31.text: Talk to the mine cart driver and get him to take you out (or pay him 100 coins).
options: You can't leave me here, I'll get killed!

32.text: Get on the mine cart.

33.text: Take Ana (in her barrel) to Irena by the Shantay Pass.

34.text: Talk to Irena to pick your two experience rewards.

35.text: You've been caught and thrown in a cell: search the window to bend its bars and climb out.

36.text: You've been thrown in the mine's cell: mine 15 rocks and give them to the guard at the gate.

deserttreasure.name: Desert Treasure
deserttreasure.start: Talk to the Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp in the desert.
skills: The Dig Site, The Tourist Trap, Temple of Ikov, Priest in Peril, Waterfall Quest and Troll Stronghold
Able to defeat Fareed (167), Damis (103 and 174), Dessous (139), Kamil (154) and 5 ice trolls
Water spells or melee with ice gloves for Fareed; fire spells for Kamil
While you carry a diamond a Stranger (level 95) may attack you
rewards: An ancient staff from Eblis (80,000 coins)

1.text: Talk to the Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp (the magic carpet from the Shantay Pass goes there).

2.text: Take the etchings to the archaeological expert in the Exam Centre, south-east of Varrock.
options: Ask about the Desert Treasure quest.

3.text: Talk to the archaeological expert again for the translation.
options: Ask about the Desert Treasure quest.

4.text: Bring the translation to the Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp.

5.text: Talk to the Archaeologist again and agree to help.

6.text: Take off any Saradomin or Zamorak items and buy a drink (650 coins) from the bartender in the Bandit Camp, south of the Bedabin Camp.

7.text: Talk to the bartender again about the four diamonds.

8.text: Talk to Eblis in the building east of the Bandit Camp's shop.
options: Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra

9.text: Use the items on Eblis (notes are fine): 12 magic logs, 6 steel bars, 6 molten glass, ashes, charcoal, a blood rune and bones.

10.text: Talk to Eblis at the mirrors on the hill south-east of the Bandit Camp.

11.text: Wear a face mask and enter the smoky well west of Pollnivneach. Bring a tinderbox, ice gloves or water runes, and energy potions.

12.text: Light the torches quickly with your tinderbox, before they burn out: start with the north-east one.

13.text: Light the south-east torch.

14.text: Light the north-west torch.

15.text: Light the south-west torch.

16.text: Open the burnt chest in the middle of the dungeon for the warm key.

17.text: Use the warm key on the gate in the east of the dungeon and go through. Without ice gloves Fareed will knock your weapon away.

18.text: Kill Fareed with water spells, or melee wearing ice gloves.

19.text: Pick up the Diamond of Smoke.

20.text: Talk to Rasolo, south of the Baxtorian Falls, about the diamonds.
options: Ask about the Diamonds of Azzanadra

21.text: Bring lockpicks, food and antipoison to the Bandit Camp and keep trying the secure chest in the south until you get Rasolo's gilded cross.

22.text: Take the gilded cross back to Rasolo.

23.text: Wear the ring of visibility and climb down the ladder east of Rasolo.

24.text: Go to the far east room of the Shadow Dungeon, wearing the ring, and wait for Damis.

25.text: Kill Damis, both forms.

26.text: Pick up the Diamond of Shadow.

27.text: Talk to Malak in the Canifis pub.
options: I am looking for a special Diamond...

28.text: Ask Malak how to kill Dessous.

29.text: With a silver bar, go down the trapdoor west of Morgan's house in Draynor Village.

30.text: Bring the silver bar to Ruantun in the Draynor sewers.

31.text: Take the silver pot to Entrana (no weapons or armour) and use it on the High Priest.

32.text: Bring the blessed pot to Malak in Canifis for some blood. He bites you for 5.

33.text: Add the garlic powder to the pot.

34.text: Add the spice to the pot.

35.text: Pour the pot on the vampyre tomb in the graveyard south-east of Canifis. Dessous wakes!

36.text: Kill Dessous.

37.text: Go back to Malak in Canifis for the Diamond of Blood.

38.text: Use a cake (or another sweet) on the troll child north of Trollheim.

40.text: Go through the ice gate east of the troll child. Past it the cold drains your stats.

41.text: Kill 5 ice trolls to thaw the cave entrance.

42.text: Enter the cave to the east and follow the path.

43.text: Follow the path until Kamil appears, and kill him with fire spells.

44.text: Wear the spiked boots and climb up the ice ledge at the end of the western path.

45.text: Follow the ice path up and go through the ice gate at the top.

46.text: Smash the two ice blocks holding the trolls at the end of the path.

48.text: Talk to the troll child by the ice gate for the Diamond of Ice.

49.text: Use the Diamond of Blood on the north-west obelisk around the pyramid south-east of the Bandit Camp.

50.text: Use the Diamond of Smoke on the north-east obelisk.

51.text: Use the Diamond of Ice on the south-east obelisk.

52.text: Use the Diamond of Shadow on the south-west obelisk.

53.text: Climb down into the pyramid from the top. Keep moving: traps can throw you out.

57.text: Go through the doorway into the room in the middle of the bottom floor.

58.text: Talk to Azzanadra to finish the quest!

1.text: Talk to Lady Servil, west-southwest of the Monastery south of Ardougne.

2.text: Search the chest to the east for some Khazard armour.

3.text: Equip Khazard armour, talk to the Khazard Guard in the southeast of the prison.

4.text: Buy Khali brew from the nearby bar to the west for 5 coins.
options: I'd like a Khali Brew please.

5.text: Take the brew back to the Khazard Guard.

6.text: Get another set of keys from the Khazard Guard

7.text: Get ready to fight the monsters (all safespottable), starting with Khazard Ogre (level 63). Use the keys on Sammy's cell door to free him.

8.text: Kill the Ogre. You can lure it behind a skeleton to safespot it.

9.text: Talk to Sammy, then fight the ogre.

10.text: Talk to Hengrad.

11.text: Talk to General Khazard.

12.text: Kill the Scorpion. You can lure it behind a skeleton to safespot it.

13.text: Talk to Sammy, then fight the scorpion.

14.text: Kill Bouncer. You can lure it behind a skeleton to safespot it. Warning: After Bouncer is killed, you will be unable to re-enter the arena.

15.text: Talk to Sammy, then fight Bouncer.

16.text: Exit the arena (can ignore General Khazard). Warning: You will be unable to re-enter the arena.

17.text: Go back to Lady Servil to end the quest.

1.text: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot Castle to start.
options: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!

2.text: Talk to Sir Gawain about how Merlin got trapped.
options: Do you know how Merlin got trapped?

3.text: Go upstairs to talk to Lancelot.

4.text: Talk to Sir Lancelot about getting into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold.
options: Any ideas on how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?

5.text: Hide in Arhein's crate behind the Candle Maker's shop in Catherby.

6.text: Hide in Arhein's crate behind the Candle Maker's shop in Catherby.

7.text: Go up the stairs in the fortress.

8.text: Go up another floor.

9.text: Attack Sir Mordred down to 0hp to cause Morgan Le Faye to spawn.
options: Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might.
Ok I will do all that.

10.text: Go through Morgan le Faye's dialog. IF YOU EXIT FROM THIS DIALOG YOU WILL HAVE TO FIGHT MORDRED AGAIN.
options: Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might.
Ok I will do all that.

11.text: Climb down from Keep Le Faye and step through the front door, then kill a Giant bat for some bat bones.

12.text: Climb down from Keep Le Faye and step through the front door, then kill a Giant bat for some bat bones.

13.text: Kill a Giant bat outside Keep Le Faye for some bat bones.

14.text: Return to Catherby.

15.text: If you still need wax, go grab the insect repellent in a house in north Catherby. Otherwise, get your wax out.

16.text: Go grab the bucket in the bee field west of Catherby.

17.text: Use the insect repellent on a bee hive, then try to take some wax.

18.text: Talk to the Candle Maker in Catherby twice until he gives you a black candle.
options: Have you got any black candles?

19.text: Talk to the Lady of the Lake in Taverley.

20.text: Attempt to enter the jewelery store in Port Sarim.

21.text: Talk to the beggar who appears and give him some bread.

22.text: Check the altar in the Zamorak Temple in south east Varrock. If you've already learnt the spell, just mark this step complete in the Quest Helper sidebar.

23.text: Enter the gates towards Camelot Castle.

24.text: Go stand in the star symbol north east of Camelot Castle.

25.text: Light the Black candle with your tinderbox.

26.text: Right-click drop the bat bones in the star.

27.text: Say the spell 'Snarthon Candtrick Termanto'. Be careful not to click the wrong option or you'll have to get another Black Candle.

28.text: Go up the ladder in the south east of Camelot castle.

29.text: Go up the next ladder.

30.text: Smash the Giant Crystal with Excalibur equipped.

31.text: Tell King Arthur you've freed Merlin.

32.text: Tell King Arthur you've freed Merlin.

33.text: Tell King Arthur you've freed Merlin.

1.text: Talk to the Boy in Taverley to start the quest.
options: Ok, I'll see what I can do.

2.text: Look under the potted plant just outside the witch's house for the house key.

3.text: Enter the witch's house.

4.text: Go back downstairs.

5.text: Go down the ladder to the basement.

6.text: Go through the gate whilst wearing gloves. If you don't have gloves, search the nearby boxes until you get a pair.

7.text: Open the cupboard and get a magnet from it

8.text: Open the cupboard and get a magnet from it

9.text: Climb back up the ladder.

10.text: Use the cheese on the mouse hole in the south room, then use the magnet on the mouse which emerges.

11.text: Pick up the witch's diary from the table and read it to ensure the door stays unlocked. Check the 'Checkpoint' section if you want to skip this step.

12.text: Enter the garden and sneak around the perimeter to search the fountain. If the witch spots you, you'll be teleported outside.

13.text: Use the shed key on the shed door to enter.

14.text: Enter the shed. If the door doesn't open, you need to get the shed key from the fountain again.

15.text: Kill all four forms of the Witch's experiment (levels 19, 30, 42, and 53). You can safe spot the last two forms from the crate in the south of the room.

16.text: If an experiment hasn't spawned, attempt to pick up the ball once.

17.text: Pick up the ball.

18.text: Return the ball to the boy. Make sure the witch doesn't spot you or you'll have to get the ball back again..

1.text: Talk to Elena in her house west of the northern Ardougne bank.

2.text: Talk to Jerico in his house south of the northern Ardougne bank

3.text: Get bird feed from the cupboard in Jerico's house.

4.text: Get a pigeon cage from behind Jerico's house.

5.text: Investigate the watchtower near the entrance to West Ardougne.

6.text: Open the Pigeon cage next to the watchtower.

7.text: Talk to Omart, south of the watchtower, to enter West Ardougne.

8.text: Squeeze through the fence to enter the Mourner's Headquarters yard in the north east of West Ardougne.

9.text: Pick up the rotten apple in the yard.

10.text: Use the rotten apple on the cauldron.

11.text: Search the cupboard in Sarah's house south-west of the West Ardougne church for a disguise.

12.text: Search the cupboard in Sarah's house south-west of the West Ardougne church for a disguise.

13.text: Enter the Mourners' Headquarters whilst wearing the medical gown.

14.text: Go upstairs and kill the mourner.

15.text: Kill the mourner here for a key to the caged area.

16.text: Search the crate in the caged area for Elena's Distillator.

17.text: Return to Elena.

options: Okay, where is he? I'll kill him for you!

options: Gypsy Aris said I should come and talk to you.

Can you give me your key?

options: Yes I know, but this is important.

options: I need to get a key given to you by Sir Prysin.

I'll get the bones for you.
